Homebuilder confidence fell to a 14-year low. ![Image 1: Stephen Alpher](https://www.coindesk.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fs3y3vcno%2Fproduction%2F9c64385838f127845d0783e09a18548c2b886ce2-512x512.png%3Fw%3D64%26h%3D64%26fit%3Dcrop%26crop%3Dfocalpoint%26auto%3Dformat&w=96&q=75) ## Board does not intend to reinstate Huang, says new Nvidia chairman Appearing on the Nvidia [NVDA$154.91·Market Closed](https://www.coindesk.com/price/stock/nvda) earnings call, longtime board member and now Chairman Harvey Jones said the board unanimously accepted Jensen Huang’s resignation and does not intend to reinstate him. He further said that management will not be taking questions regarding the circumstances of Huang’s resignation. Shares are off their best after-hours levels, but still up 1.7%. * * * ![Image 2: Stephen Alpher](https://www.coindesk.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fs3y3vcno%2Fproduction%2F9c64385838f127845d0783e09a18548c2b886ce2-512x512.png%3Fw%3D64%26h%3D64%26fit%3Dcrop%26crop%3Dfocalpoint%26auto%3Dformat&w=96&q=75) ## Bitcoin adds a bit on Nvidia relief Bitcoin [BTC$64,615.39](https://www.coindesk.com/price/bitcoin) has gained about $600 (nearly 1% these days) after Nvidia — reporting earnings just days after the departure of CEO Jensen Huang — topped analyst estimates in both the third quarter and its fourth-quarter guidance.
